facts.text: John is mentoring younger players on his team and finds it rewarding.

evidence.quote: I'm now mentoring the younger players on my team. It's super rewarding and I'm loving sharing my skills and knowledge with them.
It's been awesome gaining experience and adapting, motivating and encouraging everyone.

facts.text: John mentions that mentoring has been challenging due to the differences among the players.

evidence.quote: There are challenges, since everyone is so different.

facts.text: John expresses fulfillment in seeing the younger players develop and reach their goals.

evidence.quote: It's also a great way for me to stay involved in the game during the off-season.
It's been great to watch each of them develop and reach their goals - such a reward!

facts.text: John shared a photo of himself with some of the younger players at a recent practice.

evidence.quote: Here's a pic of me and some of the younger players at a recent practice.
